sourceMetadata.generator: generate_dataset.py (seed 20261005); output is byte-identical on every run
sourceMetadata.method: Hand-built road-corridor graph of Noida (nodes = metro stations, landmarks, sector hubs and corridor junctions; edges = Noida-Greater Noida Expressway, Aqua Line corridor, Blue Line corridor, Dadri Road, master/sector roads and link roads). Routes are least-time paths (plus via-node variants) between node pairs, selected by a seeded greedy algorithm for exactly 100 routes (25 short / 50 medium / 25 long), full endpoint coverage and corridor diversity, then densified to at most 300 m waypoint spacing. Distance is the sum of haversine distances between consecutive waypoints. Duration comes from a per-road-class speed model; averageSpeedKmph = distance / duration.
realGeographicInformation: Coordinates of Blue Line and Aqua Line metro stations, taken from the cited pages (locationBasis = verified-landmark).
Coordinates of the Sector 93A Emerald Court landmark from Wikipedia.
The existence and relative order of the corridors: Noida-Greater Noida Expressway (Mahamaya Flyover to Pari Chowk), Aqua Line, Blue Line, Dadri Road.
Real sector numbers and their rough relative positions.
simulationAssumptions: Sector hubs marked estimated-sector-hub are approximate placements (typically within several hundred metres to about 1 km) derived from nearby verified anchors; they are not surveyed coordinates.
Stations 81, 143, 145, 146 and 147 are interpolated along the Aqua Line between verified neighbours using the official station order.
Waypoints between two anchors are straight-line interpolations (kind = interpolated). Real roads bend and follow a street grid, so these are corridor approximations and not exact navigation geometry.
Corridor control points on the expressway (nge0-nge9) are estimated; the real centreline may differ by several hundred metres.

Road labels in the road field are descriptive corridor labels. Only 'Noida-Greater Noida Expressway', 'Captain Shashi Kant Marg', 'Vishwakarma Road' and 'Dadri Road' are real road names; the rest describe the corridor or link between two named places.

Speed model (moving speed by road class): expressway 38, arterial 27, sector road 21, link road 16 km/h, plus 0.25 min of signal/turn friction per edge. Route durations are modelled estimates, not observed travel times.
No GPS noise, randomness, traffic or rider behaviour is present in this file; those belong to the simulator.

locationBasisLegend.verified-landmark: Coordinate taken directly from a cited source for a real landmark (metro station, Emerald Court).
locationBasisLegend.interpolated-between-verified-landmarks: Metro station placed between two verified stations using the official station order.
locationBasisLegend.geocoded-sector-point: Third-party geocoder point for the sector; lower confidence than verified-landmark.
locationBasisLegend.estimated-sector-hub: Approximate hub for a sector placed from nearby verified anchors; lowest confidence.
locationBasisLegend.estimated-corridor-junction: Estimated control point along a named road corridor.

sourceMetadata.recommendedNextStep: Optionally run a one-time road-snapping pass (e.g. OSRM /match or /route against an OpenStreetMap extract of Noida) and regenerate; the schema will not change.
